a third-party system, which has been initiated by sending the loan request

Return a fresh signed download URL for the realty's valuation report.

Resolves the latest `RealtyValuation` with an `external_service` set
(currently Rock Estate is the only configured one), then the most recent
non-obsolete `propertyValuation` document attached to the realty, and

is admin-set per environment with no codified source-of-truth string, so
`external_service__isnull=False` is the robust equivalent today.

Error bodies carry a machine-readable `code` only (no localized prose);
the consuming client maps status/code to its own translated messaging.

item.name: api loan requests search products create

request.name: api loan requests search products create

description.content:
The DynamicProductViewSet provides a way to fetch the list of available products enriched with data
related to the loan request provided in the URL. It is used to select products to add to an offer as product items.

The list is a multiplication of the active ProductVersions with a start date of at least today and
the allowed variabilities configured for the product.
As an example:
2 Products (A & B) with each one version
Product A has 2 allowed variabilities (fix and 5-5-5)
Product B has 1 allowed variabilities (fix)
The view will return 3 results
If product A has 2 versions that have a start date of at least today, the view will return 5 results.

Next to the product details, the view runs the acceptance rules and provides the result in the errors attribute.

Developer notes:
The logic used in this view and its related code assumes that there is no offer or product items
to base calculations on.

You can define the duration you want to calculate the products for by setting the query params min_duration
and max_duration to an equal value. Otherwise, those values are only used to filter and the default duration
on the product version is used in the calculations.
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
